edges.reason: Constructor writes totalSupply using an unchecked multiplication.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
Constructor sets the token name state variable.
Constructor sets the token symbol state variable.
_transfer mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with unchecked arithmetic.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer routine after spending allowance.
transfer indirectly updates holder balances.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender], the spender authorization.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
approveAndCall invokes approve before the external notification.
approveAndCall triggers the external receiveApproval callback.
burn decrements balanceOf[msg.sender].
burn decrements totalSupply.
burnFrom decrements balanceOf[_from].
burnFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
burnFrom decrements totalSupply.
msg.sender receives the initial supply in the constructor.
msg.sender is the implicit source of transfer.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is checked and decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender owns the allowance entry written by approve.
msg.sender and its code are forwarded into the external receiveApproval callback.
msg.sender authorizes and owns the burned balance in burn.
msg.sender is the spender authorized to burn tokens of _from.
_transfer performs unchecked balance subtractions and additions.
constructor performs unchecked supply multiplication.
transferFrom performs unchecked allowance decrement.
burn performs unchecked balance and supply decrements.
burnFrom performs unchecked balance, allowance and supply decrements.
The receiveApproval external call can reenter transferFrom while allowance state is being modified.
The receiveApproval external call can reenter burnFrom.
The receiveApproval external call can reenter burn.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter initialSupply is only meaningful inside the constructor; fold it into the constructor node.
Constructor parameter tokenName is only used for the name assignment inside the constructor.
Constructor parameter tokenSymbol is only used for the symbol assignment inside the constructor.
Parameter _from of _transfer is a local input of that internal function; merge into _transfer.
Parameter _to of _transfer is a local input of that internal function; merge into _transfer.
Parameter _value of _transfer is a local input of that internal function; merge into _transfer.
Parameter _to of transfer only feeds the call to _transfer; merge into transfer.
Parameter _value of transfer only feeds the call to _transfer; merge into transfer.
Parameter _from of transferFrom only feeds allowance and _transfer logic; merge into transferFrom.
Parameter _to of transferFrom only feeds the call to _transfer; merge into transferFrom.
Parameter _value of transferFrom drives the allowance check and the transfer amount; merge into transferFrom.
Parameter _spender of approve is the allowance key; merge into approve.
Parameter _value of approve is the allowance amount; merge into approve.
Parameter _spender of approveAndCall is approved and called; merge into approveAndCall.
Parameter _value of approveAndCall is approved and forwarded; merge into approveAndCall.
Parameter _extraData is passed unmodified into the external receiveApproval call; merge into that unsafe operation.
Parameter _value of burn is the burn amount; merge into burn.
Parameter _from of burnFrom is the account being burned; merge into burnFrom.
Parameter _value of burnFrom is the burn amount; merge into burnFrom.
Local previousBalances exists only to support the assertion around the unchecked balance arithmetic; merge into that unsafe operation.
Local spender is only a wrapper used to perform the external receiveApproval call; merge into that unsafe operation.
